rationale: X independently rediscovers three of the ground truth's most severe hsliuustc0106 findings almost line-for-line: the text-encoder-tp GroupCoordinator crash (pipeline_minimax_h3.py:561-579 vs GT line 575), Ring silently ignoring packed cu_seqlens boundaries (minimax_h3_transformer.py:405-419 vs GT line 455), and the encoder loader downgrading missing weights to a warning (encoder.py:1021-1027 vs GT line 1020) — plus the unbounded-upload issue. Y spends most of its budget on verification/validation bookkeeping and finds a different, plausible-but-unconfirmed set of bugs (dead FA4 branch in ring.py, fa.py import splitting, max_seqlen_q sizing) but misses nearly all the actual planted findings, even mischaracterizing the text-encoder-tp issue as 'resolved'. Both are well-grounded with concrete file/line evidence and actionable fixes, but X's much higher recall on the true blocking bugs decides it.
